title: DC-9-50 web reference and source discovery

requestedComponents.label: captain-eye cockpit shell and main-panel silhouette
requestedComponents.acceptanceNotes: Prioritize real DC-9 cockpit references with clear captain-eye framing. Nearby DC-9 variants may only support labeled compatibility checks.

requestedComponents.label: captain and first-officer yoke family and placement
requestedComponents.acceptanceNotes: Find real-photo and extractable source candidates that clarify yoke shape, spacing, placard area, and column hierarchy.

requestedComponents.label: pedestal and throttle quadrant relationships
requestedComponents.acceptanceNotes: Record whether each source supports only placement, only buildable levers, or broader pedestal grouping.

requestedComponents.label: main panel gauge density and analog depth
requestedComponents.acceptanceNotes: Prioritize sources that clearly show round-gauge density, bezel depth, and center-panel relationships.

requestedComponents.label: overhead panel density and location
requestedComponents.acceptanceNotes: Record whether the source supports exact overhead geometry, density-only guidance, or presentation-only mood.

requestedComponents.label: windshield and sidewall framing from the captain view
requestedComponents.acceptanceNotes: Prioritize wide real-aircraft cockpit photos that preserve window post, wiper, and sidewall relationships.
